title: BSNG exploratory human-reference 10M exact-sequence recognition screen

preregisteredModel.assumptions: Exact 15bp sequence recognition of either strand; no mismatches; no physical binding mechanism specified.
preregisteredModel.motifOrigin: Earlier arbitrary synthetic software-regression fixture; not a biological target
preregisteredModel.controlMethod: 32 independently seeded shuffled 15mers preserving A/C/G/T counts, reverse-complement distinct

results.conclusion: No exact 15bp target matches, and no exact matches for controls. This interval does not discriminate target from control strings. The computation provides no nanite binding evidence.

limitations: The analyzed GRCh38 reference is not a personal genome sample.
The tested motif is not derived from a characterized BSNG receptor.
No molecular, cellular, therapeutic, ATP-energy or replicative construct was modeled or measured.
All-zero counts make the control comparison uninformative; p=1 is not a validation or physical failure of the BSNG hypothesis.
Full report/FASTA are currently stored in an expiring GitHub artifact; this summary file is persisted on the development branch.
